invariants.description: for non-negative drive, efferent firing lies between f_esinf and f_es0
invariants.expr: (np.all(f_ash < 0) | np.all((f_esh >= min(f_esinf, f_es0) - 1e-9) & (f_esh <= max(f_esinf, f_es0) + 1e-9))) & (np.all(f_asp < 0) | np.all((f_esp >= min(f_esinf, f_es0) - 1e-9) & (f_esp <= max(f_esinf, f_es0) + 1e-9))) & (np.all(f_asv < 0) | np.all((f_esv >= min(f_esinf, f_es0) - 1e-9) & (f_esv <= max(f_esinf, f_es0) + 1e-9)))

bc_sweep.rationale: afferent drive -20..80 Hz covers the range produced by the sympathetic afferent block over physiological receptor inputs (lung stretch and low f_cp make it negative); constants x0.5-x2.

baseline.reason: intermediate neuronal population of the Gee 2023 reflex network: its firing rate is not measured on its own (parameters were identified from whole-system HR/elastance/ICN data), so there is no component-level data; checked against its exact static map. Validation belongs to the assembled closed-loop model (candidate: Gee 2023 Table 2 baseline SBP/DBP/HR/CO/EF and VNS % changes).
